links.outcome: Presence of hallucination in ChatGPT-4o interpretation of imaging, labs, and treatment recommendations
links.effect: In a single case of hand arthralgia, ChatGPT-4o fabricated unsupported or inaccurate information in radiologic and laboratory analysis and in treatment recommendations.
links.quote: The AI-generated interpretation demonstrated hallucination-namely, the fabrication of unsupported or inaccurate information-in the analysis of radiologic and laboratory findings, as well as in treatment recommendations.

screen.reason: Case report evaluating ChatGPT-4o's diagnostic interpretation and hallucinations for a patient presentation, illustrating safety risks but not experimentally testing a deployment practice.
